telescope_info.source: support.itelescope.net article "Telescope 21", "iTelescope - T21 - Deep Space - Utah"
lines: Observatory: Utah Desert Remote Observatory, Great Basin Desert, Beryl Junction, Utah, USA; MPC U94
Telescope: 0.43-m f/6.8 reflector + CCD + f/4.5 focal reducer
Min target elevation: 15° all azimuths except 23° for azimuths 50-130°

Ops notes: deep field, hybrid missions, photometry and imaging, FITS and TIF; darks 60/120/180/300/600 s Bin 1-2; raw data at data.itelescope.net; 0.66 focal reducer; recommended max exposure 600 s; Planewave Ascension 200HR, active guidance disabled; 'Full House' system

CCD: FLI-PL6303E, QE 68% peak, gain 1.16 (conversion factor 1.13), full well ~100,000 e- NABG, dark ~.005 e-/px/s at -45 C, 9 µm pixels, 0.96 arcsec/pixel, frontlit, cooling -35 C default, 3072x2048 (6.3 MP), FOV 32.8 x 49.2 arcmin, position angle 359°
Filters: Astrodon LRGB 50mm; Astrodon Ha, SII, OIII (5nm) 50mm; Astrodon UBVRI Johnson/Cousins
Optics: Planewave 17" CDK, aperture 431 mm, focal length 1940 mm (0.66 reducer), f/4.5; active guiding disabled; mount Planewave Ascension 200HR
Horizon: "T21 has a partial low obstruction to the NE and SE due to the retracted observatory roof."; horizon map baseline 15°

run_saved_plan: repeats 600 s / 15° / 45°, calibration and outputs. Controls: folder dropdown "[select subfolder]"; plan list (empty); checkboxes "Send my Images to the VPhot Server (requires AAVSO membership).", "Auto Logoff."; Acquire Images button (not clicked).

workflow: Planning Tool or Telescopius for coordinates/visibility
check framing in Telescopius with correct telescope
fill Deep Sky Objects form, suggested H:M:S / D:M:S (RA 05:23:25 DEC -10:12:56)
master calibration: Bias Bin 1 & 2, Darks 900 s Bin 1 & 2 (dark scaled with bias)
Acquire images now or Create plan for later (Reservation)
watch via System Status or View Desktop
tips: stack many shorter subs (120 s x 10 = 1200 s master)
sky shot noise just exceeding dark current is ideal
brighter object shorter sub, darker filter longer
prefer #REPEAT over Qty (4x LRGB 1200 s cut at 3/4 gives L,R,G no B
notes: adaptive focus periodically and on temperature change, disabled by #FORCESTARTUP + #NOADAPTIVE.
Outputs: raw 16-bit FITS, calibrated 16-bit FITS, JPEG preview, optional 16-bit TIFF, optional calibrated FITS to VPhot..
